posts.author: Jason Beck
posts.text: Tigers infield defense didn't do Framber Valdez any favors missing chances to keep Murakami from stepping to plate in opening inning. But ...
posts.jp: タイガースの内野守備がFramber Valdezの足を引っ張った。初回に村上宗隆の打席を作らない機会を逃してしまった。だが…

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Seven scoreless for Aaron Nola, who has a 2.10 ERA over his last 10 starts (60 innings). What a boost he's given Phillies.

reply_texts.text:
Absolutely.

And going forward, the Phillies 2027 are a MUCH better team with a solid Nola.
reply_texts.author: jrvj1971.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: The Fox Broadcast had him back in for 8…🥴
reply_texts.author: atrain21.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Any reason why he didn't go out for 8th at 80 pitches?
reply_texts.author: melkasinkas.bsky.social

posts.jp: Aaron Nolaが7イニング無失点。ここ10試合（60イニング）のERAは2.10。フィリーズにとって心強い活躍だ。

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: José Ramírez Home run No. 297. 1,000 career RBIs 5-3 Cleveland
posts.jp: José Ramírezが297号ホーム。通算1,000打点到達 5-3クリーブランド

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: My goodness, an incredibly scary play at Citi Field as Nolan McLean kneed Jared Young in the head. Credit to the EMTs at Citi Field who were quick on the scene to stabilize Young, who appeared to be out cold. Scary scary scary.
posts.jp: シティフィールドで恐ろしいプレー発生。Nolan McLeanがJared Youngの頭に膝で当たってしまった。Youngを現地で素早く対応したEMT隊員に感謝。Youngは意識を失った状態だった。本当に怖い。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Death, taxes, Ian Happ hitting a home run in Cincinnati. Happ goes deep, his 24th of the year, to tie the game at 2 in the 3rd. Happ entered today with a career 1.002 OPS at Great American Ball Park, his best at any MLB stadium, and now 19 career homers here, tops for any road park.
posts.jp: またもやIan Happがシンシナティでホーム！通算24号で3回に同点。Happは大リーグ球場中でここ（Great American Ball Park）が最高のOPS 1.002。敵地での通算ホームは19本でトップ。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Dansby Swanson has been activated from the IL. BJ Murray Jr. optioned to Triple-A Iowa.
posts.jp: Dansby SwansonがILから復帰。BJ Murray Jr.はTriple-Aアイオワにオプション。

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: The simple version is that the #BlueJays are now three games back from a playoff spot with eight games left, whether they’re chasing the White Sox or the Guardians. Chicago goes 4-4? They need 7-1. Chicago goes 5-3? They need 8-0. Add in the Rangers? This is not good.

reply_texts.text:
It’s over. I’ve been an optimist through all of this, but tonight was awful. 

If the team can’t pick of the best starter we’ve had all year in a a bad night, then they’re not going far even  if they make the off-season. 

It looks like they have all checked out.
reply_texts.author: derek.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: There was hope only because the AL is littered with sub-500 teams. But with a brittle staff of starting pitchers and an utterly dismal year from the $50 million dollar man, this team is exactly where they deserve to be.
reply_texts.author: trippsteve.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: It’s been a long shot for a while with so many teams in the mix. They gave us some brief hope but it’s most likely over now.
reply_texts.author: whitbywino.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Especially not good with the Sox playing the Royals and Rockies, mostly at home. They’d have to completely fall apart to not win 4-5 of those. Incredible tbat the pitching was so good, that just one fewer injury and they might’ve carried a bottom-3 offence to the playoffs.
reply_texts.author: buddytheelf.bsky.social

posts.jp: ブルージェイズは残り8試合で、プレーオフ圏外3ゲーム差。ホワイトソックスかガーディアンズか。シカゴが4-4なら7-1必須。5-3なら8-0。レンジャーズも絡むと…詰んでる。

posts.author: Chandler Rome
posts.text: Before Mauricio Dubón's first plate appearance at Daikin Park, Christian Vázquez stepped in front of home plate in order for the crowd to give him a longer ovation. Dubón doffed his helmet.
posts.jp: Mauricio DubónのDaikin Park初打席前、Christian Vázquezが本塁前に出てファンのスタンディングオベーションを長引かせた。Dubónがヘルメットを脱いだ。
